x: The race resulted in a win for Dabbs with Flanagan 2nd and Boreham 3rd. The winner's time of 4.39 was a long way behind Ray Tooby's record of 4.28.
A Club mile handicap saw Boreham, Dooley and Reeves take the awards in that order. A team walk of two miles gave Belgrave a win over the Met.

Jim Heathfiekd won the 880 yards in 2mins. 1.6s. using tactics that paid a good dividend. Steve Boreham ran well in the mile as also did Shippen. This lad can be a good prospect with another winter over the country.
